description:
Glaxnimate is an open-source vector animation and motion design desktop application.
Features:
· Tweening
· Precompositions
· Time Stretching
· Motion Along Path
· Shape Modifiers
· Text Support
· Animated Gradients
· Raster to Vector
· Scripting Support
Supported file formats:
· Lottie
· Animated SVG
· Animated WebP
· Animated Vector Drawables
· RIVE
· Video Export
· Spritesheet Export
